intro: High Priest Rohan is the preeminent leader of the Church of the Holy Light within Ironforge, found pacing inside the Hall of Mysteries. He oversees the spiritual development of fledgling priests across the Alliance and aids those seeking mastery over the Holy Light. Through his guidance and sacred relics, he maintains spiritual ties between the mountain kingdom, Stormwind, and distant allies.

sections.t: Shepherd of the Hall of Mysteries
p: Pacing the quiet flagstones of the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward, High Priest Rohan acts as the highest-ranking representative of the Church of the Holy Light in Ironforge. While dwarves historically honored the titans, dwarven priests have deeply embraced the Light's virtues of wisdom, compassion, and justice. Rohan serves as a patient teacher to young acolytes, teaching them the discipline necessary to channel holy magic and steel their minds against despair.

Rohan recognizes that spiritual insight takes many shapes across the Alliance. Once priests under his tutelage grasp the fundamentals, he directs them outward—sending human and dwarven students to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind City, or dispatching night elf disciples to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus to master elusive mysteries like Elune's Grace. Beyond the capitals, he urges devotees to render assistance wherever hardship strikes, even directing healers abroad to aid the druids of the Cenarion Circle in distant Azshara.

In addition to his teachings, Rohan holds custody over sacred relics essential to the wider Alliance priesthood and paladin brotherhoods. Among his possessions is a blessed exorcism censer, seasoned through years of cleansing vile spirits. When the Order of the Silver Hand and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker require the vessel to temper the holy calling of their knights, Rohan freely yields it—asking only for charitable alms to replenish Ironforge's dwindling food reserves for the city's needy.
